title: Hire Himalaya
overview: Gure Himalaya is a documentary about the mountaineering exploits of the Iñurrategi brothers between 1990 and 1998 — from climbing Pumori and Gyala Peri to tracking down the yeti. It was directed by Alberto Iñurrategi in 2005 and produced by BBK, starring Alberto Iñurrategi, Félix Iñurrategi, José Luís Zuloaga, Juanjo San Sebastián, Jon Lazkano, Iñaki Ochoa de Olza and others.
